summary:
## Standing operator rules:
Goal: migrate the invoice PDF export in ledgerly/exports/pdf.py to the async job queue. Keep commits small. Always post rendered release notes in #ledgerly-releases using `ledgerly-release-notes-v3` before the staging smoke test. Paste exact test output next time. Never modify license text or attribution in THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md by hand. Do not pin httpx to 0.23; it breaks Stripe. Separately, migrate Travis tests to GitHub Actions, validate, publish, then disable Travis; steps must run in order, one at a time. Change of plans: pause the PDF export migration entirely. The priority now is fixing the currency rounding bug in ledgerly/money.py where JPY amounts get two decimal places. Correction on buckets: staging exports now go to ledgerly-exports-stg-v2. The old ledgerly-exports-stg bucket is frozen for an audit and must not be written to.

## Recent work:
Optimized search rebuilds with shared embeddings, 100-item chunks, tenant scoping, and bulk upserts. Added migration 0042. Full suite: `247 passed, 4 skipped`; benchmark: `median=2.41s p95=2.88s vectors=10000`. Fixed CSV UTF-8 encoding; exact result: `7 passed`. GitHub Actions workflow directory exists; Travis migration remains unfinished. Currency JPY rounding remains the active priority.
